description: List open time slots for a Cicero consultation event type over a date range. Returns UTC ISO-8601 start/end instants the guest can book.

days.description: Alternative to "to": number of days after "from" to search (default 30).

eventTypeSlug.description: The event type to book, e.g. "cicero-consult".

from.description: ISO-8601 start of the search window. Defaults to now.

to.description: ISO-8601 end of the search window. Defaults to 30 days after "from". Windows wider than 62 days are clamped.

name: list_consult_availability
